ops.text: Where the mean molecular weight of a planet has been measured independently, the reference can also be rescaled directly: at fixed gravity and temperature the modulation scales as $1/\mu$ and the noise as $N^{-1/2}$, so the required number of transits grows as $(\mu/2.3)^{2}$. For TOI-8264 b, a temperate sub-Neptune in our sample, adopting the mean molecular weight retrieved from its JWST NIRISS/SOSS and NIRSpec/G395H spectrum (Vachon et al., 2026) multiplies the published MCS requirement of seven Tier-2 transits by 2.42, to 17 transits.
TOI-8264 b, whose JWST transmission spectrum indicates an atmospheric metallicity of about $62\times$ solar (Vachon et al., 2026), lies close to this regime.
